caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects with a rust-colored, textured surface. Both objects appear to be heavy and have irregular, intertwined forms. The object on the left side of the image consists of multiple curved, hollow elements that are attached together at a central axis, with open, rounded ends and fork-like extensions. The object on the right is composed of a thick, circular band at the top with several intersecting flat and angular bands below, creating a geometric, almost knot-like structure. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there are no other elements or details present apart from the artist’s signature in the bottom right corner. The overall arrangement places the objects diagonally opposite each other, occupying the left and right of the composition, with both objects rendered in detailed brown tones suggestive of oxidized metal.
title: Branding Iron
